articles.title: What's next as hot money cycle has gone from crypto to gold to AI to memory
articles.snippet: As bitcoin and gold momentum fades, investor flows are increasingly rotating into AI infrastructure, semiconductor and memory-related equities.

articles.title: Bitcoin funding spike shows longs defending $70K: Will ETF outflows reverse bulls’ efforts?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin dropped closer to a critical support level as spot and long futures traders’ efforts to hold $75,000 failed. Is sub-$70,000 BTC next?

articles.title: Bitcoin miner inflows to Binance soar as BTC struggles to hold uptrend: Is $70K next?
articles.snippet: Weakening spot demand, miner inflows to exchanges and freshly opened shorts put downside pressure on Bitcoin price.

articles.title: PACs laud Texas primary wins, look to back more pro-crypto candidates
articles.snippet: While crypto-backed candidates won runoffs in Texas on Tuesday, industry PACs have less of a stake in California races next week.

articles.title: Bitcoin Traders Increasingly Convinced Price Will Fall Below $70K by End of May
articles.snippet: Prediction market odds are rising for Bitcoin to drop below $70,000 in the next few days following a dip to a six-week low price.
